transcript:
## COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS

Town of Sutton

Pursuant to GL Chapter 30A, §§ 18-25 you are hereby notified of a meeting which includes the following agenda

Board/Committee: Board of Assessors

Date/Time: November 24, 2026 - 5:00 PM

Town Hall, Assessor's Office – In Person

1. Open meeting and review Agenda
2. Approve Minutes of November 17, 2026
3. Approve Executive Minutes of November 17, 2026
4. The Board will review the bill file process for the FY27 Actual billing
5. The Board will review the Wilkinsonville and Manchaug Water Districts and their process in the billing and how to better the process
6. The Principal Assessor will go over her proposed budget for FY28
7. The Board will review Exemption Applications as they are submitted
8. The Board will review Chapter Land Applications as they are submitted
9. Board members will each work on individual projects as needed weekly
10. Sign documents
11. Other Business Not Anticipated
12. Meet in Executive Session to review abatement and/or exemption applications

Pursuant to G.L. c.30A, §21(a)(7) ("Purpose 7"), the Board will meet in executive session to discuss, comply with, and/or act under the authority of G.L. c.59, §60; votes may be taken

13. Adjourn meeting from the executive session – the Board will not reconvene in an open session
